problem.text: Each Job.receive_logits call checked logit batch size, prefill readiness and sequence liveness before sampling. The change comments out these three assertions.

reasoning.text: Avoiding repeated validation on the per-token path is a plausible performance rationale, rather than a change to the sampling algorithm. No speedup is established.

impact.text: Sampling arguments, token constraints and return handling remain unchanged. Invalid state no longer receives these early assertion failures; normal scheduling still filters unready jobs and constructs per-job logit slices.

source_notes.text: The root generation entry was read. It describes the scheduler/readiness contract and records incomplete optional probability outputs in receive_logits.

Issue #12, “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions,” reports a Job constructor failure and a discussion recommending chatml mode. Its connection here is only an inferred shared-file relationship: the traceback matches the constructor's unchanged stop-condition validation, not the sampling assertions.

limitations: No inference workload, GPU test or timing benchmark was run. The standard-library check models conditional assignments and integer state transitions, not repository tensor execution.

Whole-tree receive_logits search found one active direct caller and one commented-out threaded caller. No invalid-state route through the inspected active caller was established; external direct calls and custom model behavior remain unverified.

claims.text: The removed checks guaranteed, when assertions were enabled, one logit row per job sequence, kv_position equal to sequence length minus one, and truthy live flags. The minus one leaves the final token for the next decode forward pass. No replacement validation is added.

Generator.iterate_gen remains the sole active direct caller found by whole-tree search. It skips unready jobs while assembling inputs, records their row boundaries, skips empty slices and passes one token-position slice at a time to receive_logits. receive_sample appends a token and increments each sequence's KV position, preserving the readiness relation during ordinary acceptance, including successive accepted draft tokens.

Sequence initializes live=True; the generator-subtree search found no other live access beyond that initialization and the removed assertion. Thus this check does not track allocation or completion transitions in the inspected implementation.

A scalar check preserved readiness after incrementing both sequence length and KV position for lengths 1, 10 and 100. A separate transcription returned the ordinary four-item tuple with optional outputs disabled and raised UnboundLocalError for each enabled optional-output branch.
The optional-output defect recorded by the ancestor remains in the changed function: the task modifies only assertions, leaving the TODO/pass branches and their unassigned return variables intact.

findings.description: Inherited optional probability/top-token output failure persists in receive_logits.
findings.trigger: A job reaches sampling with return_probs=True or return_top_tokens greater than zero.
findings.expected_behavior: Return the requested probability or top-token values alongside the sampled token.
findings.actual_behavior: Enabled branches execute pass and leave next_prob or next_k_tokens/next_k_probs unassigned, so tuple construction raises UnboundLocalError. The active Generator.iterate_gen caller unpacks this tuple without handling that failure locally.

verification.description: Compared unchanged conditional assignments and tuple return with the active caller and assertion-only diff.
Reimplemented the optional conditional assignments using a scalar token; each enabled option raised UnboundLocalError.
verification.limits: Tests Python control flow only, not the sampler or probability computation.

annotation.summary: Comments out three per-token sampling assertions while retaining scheduler-side readiness filtering. Performance is unmeasured; the inherited optional-output failure remains.
